title: OpenVINO: Intel's Edge Inference Toolkit
description: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying neural networks on CPUs, iGPUs, NPUs, and VPUs — converting models to its Intermediate Representation and executing with hardware-specific kernels. It makes low-power edge inference fast. The toolkit for heterogeneous Intel silicon.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Model Optimizer and IR Format
description: OpenVINO's Model Optimizer converts ONNX/TensorFlow/PyTorch models into the Intermediate Representation (.xml + .bin) — graph optimizations, constant folding, and layout transforms applied once. Convert once, run everywhere Intel. The IR is the deployment artifact.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: INT8 Quantization and POT
description: OpenVINO's Post-Training Optimization Tool quantizes models to INT8 with minimal accuracy loss — 4x smaller, 2-4x faster on supporting hardware. Accuracy-aware methods keep the drop near 1%. Quantization is the standard edge optimization.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Heterogeneous Execution: HETERO Plugin
description: The HETERO plugin splits a model across devices — heavy layers on NPU, odd ops on CPU — automatically. Developers target 'HETERO:NPU,CPU' and the runtime places work. Heterogeneous means using all the silicon, not just one chip.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: NPU: Neural Processing Units
description: Intel NPUs (in Core Ultra and edge parts) run neural workloads at watts, not tens of watts — TOPS per watt is the edge metric. OpenVINO targets them natively. The NPU is why laptops now do local AI all day.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: iGPU and VPU Acceleration
description: OpenVINO also drives Intel iGPUs and Movidius VPUs — the integrated graphics and vision sticks that already ship in millions of devices. Existing hardware becomes inference hardware. No new silicon required.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: NNCF: Neural Network Compression
description: NNCF (Neural Network Compression Framework) adds quantization-aware training, pruning, and mixed precision — squeezing models beyond post-training methods. Train with compression in mind, deploy smaller. The research-grade toolkit inside OpenVINO.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Model Serving: OVMS
description: OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS) serves IR models over REST/gRPC with versioning and batching — the production front door for OpenVINO models. Edge fleets serve from OVMS instances. Inference as a service, locally.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Benchmark App: Measuring Reality
description: OpenVINO's benchmark_app measures latency and throughput per device and precision — the numbers that size deployments. Async mode shows max throughput; sync shows worst latency. Measure on the target, not the workstation.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Preprocessing Inside the Graph
description: OpenVINO bakes preprocessing — resize, normalize, color convert — into the IR graph so the runtime does it on-device optimally. No more Python preprocessing bottlenecks. The graph owns the whole pipeline.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Dynamic Shapes and Auto-Batching
description: OpenVINO handles dynamic input shapes and auto-batches requests — real deployments face varying inputs, and the runtime adapts instead of failing. Flexibility without recompilation. Production is dynamic.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Edge Deployments: Retail to Factory
description: OpenVINO deploys vision AI at retail (shelf monitoring), factories (defect detection), and cities (traffic) — low-power boxes doing real inference. The toolkit's breadth shows in deployment count. Edge AI is already ordinary.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Accuracy Validation After Optimization
description: Every optimization re-validates accuracy against the FP32 baseline — the accuracy checker in the toolkit automates it. Optimizations that break accuracy get rejected. Speed never outranks correctness.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: OpenVINO + ONNX Ecosystem
description: OpenVINO ingests ONNX natively — the lingua franca of trained models — so PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX exports flow straight in. The ecosystem converges on interchange. Train anywhere, optimize here.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: The OpenVINO Deployment Picture
description: Ladder-top OpenVINO: convert to IR, quantize, target heterogeneous silicon, serve with OVMS, validate accuracy. Fifteen rungs from a trained model to fast inference on watts.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.
